entities.summary: Thomas Brad "Trey" Hillman is an American professional baseball coach and manager. He has served as the manager of the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB), the Kansas City Royals in Major League Baseball (MLB) and the SK Wyverns in the KBO League. He has also been a coach for the Los Angeles Dodgers, New York Yankees, Houston Astros, and the Miami Marlins.
